config.sqlTemplate: SELECT sum(Value) AS usd FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
SELECT uniqExact(Attributes['session.id']) AS sessions FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)
SELECT round(100 * sumIf(Value, Attributes['query_source'] = 'subagent') / sum(Value), 1) AS pct FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

SELECT round(100 * sumIf(Value, Attributes['type'] = 'cacheRead') / sumIf(Value, Attributes['type'] IN ('cacheRead','cacheCreation','input')), 1) AS pct FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.token.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix)

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, Attributes['model'] AS model, sum(Value) AS usd FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY ts, model ORDER BY ts

tiles.name: Spend over time by harness version

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, Attributes['harness.version'] AS harness_version, sum(Value) AS usd FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY ts, harness_version ORDER BY ts

tiles.name: Spend by agent, model and effort

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT if(Attributes['agent.name'] = '', '(main)', Attributes['agent.name']) AS agent, Attributes['model'] AS model, Attributes['effort'] AS effort, round(sum(Value), 4) AS usd, uniqExact(Attributes['session.id']) AS sessions FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY agent, model, effort ORDER BY usd DESC LIMIT 50

tiles.name: Spend by cost variant and delegation stance

config.sqlTemplate: SELECT Attributes['harness.version'] AS harness_version, Attributes['harness.cost'] AS cost_variant, Attributes['harness.delegation'] AS delegation, round(sum(Value), 4) AS usd, uniqExact(Attributes['session.id']) AS sessions, round(sum(Value) / uniqExact(Attributes['session.id']), 4) AS usd_per_session FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY harness_version, cost_variant, delegation ORDER BY usd DESC

SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, Attributes['type'] AS token_type, sum(Value) AS tokens FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.token.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY ts, token_type ORDER BY ts

SELECT Attributes['session.id'] AS session, min(TimeUnix) AS first_seen, round(sum(Value), 4) AS usd, round(sumIf(Value, Attributes['query_source'] = 'subagent'), 4) AS subagent_usd FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName = 'claude_code.cost.usage' AND $__timeFilter(TimeUnix) GROUP BY session ORDER BY usd DESC LIMIT 25
